notes: Sync now refreshes Identity findings too, not just tenant info and Conditional Access. Previously identity data only appeared after the nightly scan, so a freshly-consented tenant looked empty until the next morning — now one Sync runs the identity scan for that tenant on the spot.

Sync now reloads the page when it finishes, so the data it just fetched actually shows up without a manual refresh. Partial results (a product not yet activated, or a scan step your tenant plan doesn't cover) no longer turn the whole Sync red.
